verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a scriptable CLI. It can scan directories and files (`gitleaks dir`) and streamed input (`gitleaks stdin`), and it runs as a pre-commit hook and in GitHub Actions on PRs. So AI-generated code can be caught before it lands, but only by generic wiring, not a documented coding-agent integration. It also only detects secrets, not broader code issues. Missing for 10: first-party coding-agent integration (MCP server, agent hook or plugin docs), llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, broader issue scanning beyond secrets, and independent corroboration of agent workflows.
